item.title: 【UPSCALED】Kanye West - Love Lockdown (versions in 8K, 4K and 1080p with ALAC audio)
item.description:
All screenshots are from the 8K version.

















Notes: I can't tell you for how long I've been waiting for a high-quality version of this video since 2008... I made the 8K upscale first in ProRes and then downgraded it to the lower resolutions.

Source: MXF 512i master + Audio from the master itself (PCM, 24 bits)

Codec #1: 4320p (8K) HEVC video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container
Codec #2: 2160p (4K) HEVC video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container
Codec #3: 1080p (Full HD) H264 video/Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio/MP4 container
